scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @certjs/db && npm run build -w @certjs/queue && npm run build -w @certjs/core && npm run build -w @certjs/storage-contract && npm run build -w @certjs/storage-s3 && npm run build -w @certjs/storage
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @certjs/api && npm run build -w @certjs/worker && npm run build -w @certjs/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @certjs/api && npm run build -w @certjs/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @certjs/api && npm run lint -w @certjs/worker && npm run lint -w @certjs/web
scripts.lint:server: npm run lint -w @certjs/api && npm run lint -w @certjs/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @certjs/api && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/worker && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/web && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/db && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/queue && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/core && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/storage-contract && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/storage-s3 && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/storage
scripts.typecheck:server: npm run typecheck -w @certjs/api && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/worker && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/db && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/queue && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/core && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/storage-contract && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/storage-s3 && npm run typecheck -w @certjs/storage
